name: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces
problem: The state space model x' = Ax + Bu, y = Cx + Du can represent long-range dependencies, but computing it naively is prohibitively expensive in both time and memory - so the theoretical strength of the SSM view was unusable.
mechanism: A new parameterisation of the SSM. The HiPPO matrix A is made NORMAL (structured as the product of a diagonal and an orthogonal matrix) and combined with a low-rank correction, which makes it STABLY DIAGONALISABLE. Diagonalising collapses the SSM computation into a convolution with a CAYLEY KERNEL, which in turn can be evaluated with FFTs - the entire efficiency win comes from that reduction.
speedup_reported: Paper's own claims (abstract): 91% accuracy on sequential CIFAR-10 with no data augmentation or auxiliary losses, on par with a larger 2-D ResNet; generation 60x faster (baseline class: the Transformers it closes the gap to); SoTA on every Long Range Arena task including Path-X at length 16K which all prior work fails on, while being as efficient as all competitors.
notes: arXiv ID 2111.00396 verified via abs-page meta tags on 2026-10-03; title matches. Venue verified strongly: arXiv comment reads 'ICLR 2022 (Outstanding Paper HM)'; OpenReview (api v1) returns venue='ICLR 2022 Oral' / venueid='ICLR.cc/2022/Conference'; and the title appears in the official ICLR 2022 virtual papers listing (iclr.cc/virtual/2022/papers.html). The source note's 'Semantic Scholar gives year 2021' is the arXiv v1 date (2021-10-31), not the venue year - year=2022 is correct here. adoption=research-only, and the reasoning is the decision-relevant part: state-spaces/s4 was last pushed 2024-07-17, roughly two years stale, and neither vLLM nor SGLang nor transformers has an S4 model - the maintained successor is the selective SSM in mamba, recorded separately. So S4 is not abandoned (its repo lives, and the outstanding-paper HM is a real contribution) but it has no path into a serving engine: the Cauchy-kernel FFT formulation has no decode-time incremental form, which is exactly what a serving engine needs. Recorded research-only rather than abandoned with that stated basis.
